items.title: 5.12 Bernoulli ke usool ke istemalat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.12 with Figs. 5.17 to 5.23 (PDF 109-112).

blocks.text: Bohat se aalaat (devices) us pressure ke farq se kaam karte hain jo fluid ki speed badalne se paida hota hai.
1. Aeroplane ke par (wings)

Aeroplane ka par is tarah banaya jata hai ke hawa mur jaye aur par ke oopar streamlines neeche ke muqable zyada qareeb hon (Fig. 5.17). Hum dekh chuke hain ke jahan streamlines qareeb hon wahan speed zyada hoti hai. Is liye par ke oopar hawa neeche se tez chalti hai. Par ke oopar pressure kam aur neeche zyada hota hai, is liye par oopar ki taraf dhakela jata hai; aeroplane ki lift (oopar uthne wali force) isi asar se hai.

blocks.alt: Hawai jahaz ke pichhle hisse ka pehloo se manzar, aage par (wing) ka section. Baen se aati sabz streamlines par ki muri hui oopri satah par bohat qareeb jama hoti hain aur neeche phaili rehti hain, sab daen taraf chalti hain. Par ke neeche surkh teer oopar ki taraf hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.17: Hawai jahaz ki lift (kitab ki Figure 5.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jahan streamlines qareeb hain wahan hawa tez aur pressure kam hai. Par ke oopar hawa tez (pressure kam) aur neeche aahista (pressure zyada) hai; neeche ka zyada pressure (laal teer) par ko oopar dhakelta hai: yahi lift hai.
2. Gend ka swing

Jab gend spin ke saath phenki ya kick ki jaye (kitab ke mutabiq bowler gend ko ek taraf se chikna rakhta hai aur doosri taraf khurdari rehti hai), to gend ke ek taraf hawa tez aur doosri taraf aahista chalti hai. Bernoulli's equation ke mutabiq tez hawa kam pressure aur aahista hawa zyada pressure banati hai. Is pressure ke farq se ek sideways (pehlu ki taraf) force paida hoti hai jise Magnus effect kehte hain, aur gend hawa mein mur jati hai.

blocks.alt: Hawa ki dhaar mein gend, hawa daen se baen chalti hai. Gend ke oopar streamlines qareeb (Faster air, lower pressure), neeche phaili hui (Slower air, higher pressure). Deflection force ka teer gend se oopar hai. Chhoti tasveer (Spinning ball) mein ghoomti gend ka rasta dashed seedhi lakeer se oopar mur jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.18: Turbulent flow (ghoomti gend ke gird hawa ka bahao) (kitab ki Figure 5.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gend ke oopar hawa tez aur pressure kam hai, neeche hawa aahista aur pressure zyada; is farq se force (deflection force) gend ko oopar, yani kam pressure ki taraf, morti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne is tasveer (Fig. 5.18) ka caption ‘Turbulent flow’ likha hai, jo asal mein Fig. 5.13 ka caption hai. Yeh tasveer ghoomti gend ke gird hawa ka bahao (Magnus effect) dikhati hai.
3. Filter Pump

Filter pump ke beech mein tangi (constriction) hoti hai, is liye nal se aane wala pani ka jet wahan tez behta hai. Is se wahan pressure gir jata hai aur side tube se hawa andar aa jati hai. Hawa aur pani mil kar pump ke neeche wale hisse se bahar nikal jate hain.

blocks.alt: Filter pump ka andaruni khaaka. Pani oopar ki tube (Water) se aata hai aur tang nozzle se tez dhaar ban kar pump ke jism mein neeche jata aur neeche ke munh se nikalta hai. Daen taraf side tube (Air flow) par teer hawa ko dhaar ki taraf andar aata dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.19: Turbulent flow (filter pump) (kitab ki Figure 5.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Fig. 5.19 ka caption bhi ‘Turbulent flow’ likha hai, lekin yeh filter pump ki tasveer hai: tangi par tez jet pressure kam karta hai aur side tube se hawa kheench leta hai.
4. Carburetor

Car engine ka carburetor cylinders ko hawa aur petrol ka sahi mixture dene ke liye Venturi duct (beech se patli nali) istemal karta hai. Hawa duct se guzar kar ek pipe ke zariye cylinders tak jati hai. Duct ke kinare ek chhota sa inlet (soorakh) hai jis mein petrol aata hai.
Duct mein hawa bohat tez chalti hai, is liye duct mein pressure kam ho jata hai, aur yeh kam pressure petrol ke vapours (bukharat) ko hawa ki dhaar mein kheench leta hai.

blocks.alt: Khara Venturi duct jis mein oopar se Air dakhil hoti hai. Duct tang gale (throat) tak sukarta hai, jahan neeche ki taraf teeron wali streamlines qareeb aa jati hain, aur phir neeche chaura ho jata hai. Gale par Low pressure likha hai. Baen taraf Gas ka khana, Atmospheric pressure par, ek muri pipe se gale se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.20: Engine ka carburetor (kitab ki Figure 5.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Throat (duct ka patla hissa) mein hawa tez hai is liye pressure kam hai. Petrol ke khane par bahar ki hawa ka (atmospheric) pressure hai jo zyada hai; yahi farq petrol ko pipe se throat mein dhakel kar hawa mein mila deta hai.
5. Paint Sprayer

Liquid mein doobi tube ke oopar se hawa ki dhaar guzre to liquid tube mein oopar charh jata hai (Fig. 5.21). Yeh asar perfume ki botlon aur paint sprayers mein istemal hota hai. Atomizer ki rubber ki gend dabane se hawa tube mein se tez speed se patle munh (aperture) se nikalti hai aur wahan pressure gir jata hai. Is liye bahar ka atmospheric pressure perfume ko dhakel kar oopar patle munh tak le aata hai.

blocks.alt: Neela teer Air ko ek line mein dakhil hota dikhata hai jo daen taraf Nozzle tak tang hoti hai. Nozzle se ek khari tube surkh Paint ke bartan mein doobi hai; surkh teer paint ko tube mein oopar uthta aur nozzle se phuhaar (spray) bante dikhate hain. Neele teer bartan ke andar paint ki satah par neeche dabate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.21: Liquid mein doobi tube ke oopar se guzarti hawa ki dhaar (kitab ki Figure 5.21 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Nozzle par hawa bohat tez hai, is liye tube ke oopar pressure kam ho jata hai. Paint ki satah par hawa ka pressure (neele teer) zyada hai; yahi pressure paint ko tube mein oopar dhakelta hai. Paint kheencha nahi jata, dhakela jata hai.
6. Venturi Relation
Ek pipe lein jis mein density ρ wala fluid mukhtalif cross-sectional areas se guzar raha hai (Fig. 5.22).
Chaure (wide) sire par cross-sectional area A₁ aur patle (narrow) hisse par A₂ hai.
Chaure aur patle hisson mein flow ki speeds v₁ aur v₂ hain. Manometer (pressure napne wali U-tube) ki dono shakhein (limbs) jorne se dono hisson ka pressure P₁ aur P₂ maloom hota hai.

blocks.alt: Ufqi pipe: baen taraf chaura hissa A1, beech mein tang gala A2 aur daen phir chaura. Teen streamlines gale se guzarte hue qareeb aa jati hain; chaure hisse mein v1 aur gale mein v2. Neeche U-tube manometer chaure hisse aur gale ko jorta hai: chaure hisse ke neeche satah P1 neechi hai aur gale ke neeche satah P2 us se h oonchi.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.22: Venturi meter (kitab ki Figure 5.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chaure hisse mein pressure P₁ zyada hai, is liye woh manometer ke liquid ko apni taraf zyada neeche dabata hai; throat mein speed zyada aur pressure P₂ kam hai, is liye wahan liquid h oonchai tak charh jata hai.
Pipe horizontal hai, is liye dono jagah average potential energy barabar hai (ρgh wali terms kat jati hain).
Is liye Bernoulli's equation yeh ban jati hai:

blocks.title: Interesting Information
blocks.text: Horizontal pipe ke liye Bernoulli's equation se saaf hai ke “jahan speed zyada ho, wahan pressure kam hota hai”. Riyazi (mathematical) shakal:
Equation of continuity se:

Figure se zahir hai ke A₂ < A₁, is liye v₁ v₂ ke muqable bohat chhota hai: chaure hisse mein fluid patle hisse se bohat aahista chalta hai. Is liye Eq. (5.25) ke daen hisse mein v₁ ko chhor (neglect kar) sakte hain:
Ise Venturi relation kehte hain. Yeh venturi meter mein istemal hoti hai, jo liquid ke bahao ki speed napne ka aala hai.
7. Torricelli's Theorem
Bernoulli's equation ka ek saada istemal Fig. 5.23 mein hai. Ek bari tanki mein do chhote soorakh (orifices) A aur B hain. Hum dekhte hain ke soorakh A se pani kis speed se nikalta hai.

blocks.alt: Pani ki oonchi tanki, jis ki satah speed v1 se neeche aati hai aur tah se oonchai h1 par hai. Daen taraf surakh A, tah se oonchai h2 par aur satah se h1 - h2 neeche, se speed v2 ki dhaar mur kar neeche girti hai. Baen taraf neeche surakh B se tube dhaar ko oopar morti hai (speed v3) aur pani tanki ki satah ki oonchai tak uthta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.23: Surakh wali fluid ki tanki (kitab ki Figure 5.23 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Soorakh A se nikalne ki speed v₂ = √(2g(h₁ − h₂)), bilkul us gend ki speed jaisi jo (h₁ − h₂) oonchai se gire. Soorakh B ki dhaar oopar mori jaye to yahi K.E. use tanki ki satah tak utha deti hai.

Soorakh bohat chhote hain, is liye nikalne wale pani ki speeds (efflux speeds) v₂ aur v₃ tanki ki oopar wali satah ki speed v₁ se bohat zyada hain; is liye v₁ ko taqreeban zero le sakte hain. Bernoulli's equation:

blocks.latex: P_1 + \rho g h_1 = P_2 + \frac{1}{2}\rho v_2^2 + \rho g h_2

blocks.text: Is liye equation ban jati hai:
Yeh Torricelli's theorem hai, jo kehta hai:

blocks.title: Torricelli's theorem
blocks.text: Soorakh se nikalne wale fluid ki speed (speed of efflux) us velocity ke barabar hai jo fluid gravity ke zor se (h₁ − h₂) faasla girne mein hasil karta hai.

Dekhein ke nikalne wale liquid ki speed us gend ki speed jitni hai jo (h₁ − h₂) oonchai se gire. Tanki ki oopar wali satah thori neeche aati hai aur us ki P.E. nikalne wale fluid ki K.E. ban jati hai. Agar soorakh B par dhaar oopar ki taraf mori jaye (Fig. 5.23), to yeh K.E. liquid ko tanki ke pani ki satah tak utha degi. Asal mein viscosity ki wajah se energy ka kuch nuqsan hota hai, is liye nateeja thora sa badal jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan ‘Fig.6.4’ ka hawala deti hai, magar chapter 5 mein koi Fig. 6.4 nahi. Soorakh A aur B wali tanki Fig. 5.23 hai, is liye sahi hawala Fig. 5.23 hai.

blocks.caption: Aalaat aur Bernoulli ka asar
rows: P₁ − P₂ = ½ρv₂² se speed napi jati hai

blocks.prompt: Tanki mein pani ki satah se 5 m neeche ek soorakh hai; pani kis speed se niklega? Tez chalti train ke qareeb khara hona khatarnak kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Torricelli se v = √(2gh) = √(2 × 9.8 × 5) = √98 ≈ 9.9 m s⁻¹. Train apne saath hawa ko tez ghaseet-ti hai, is liye train aur aap ke darmiyan hawa ka pressure aap ke peechhe ki ruki hawa se kam ho jata hai; yeh pressure ka farq aap ko train ki taraf dhakel sakta hai (Bernoulli: jahan speed zyada, pressure kam).

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Tez fluid, kam pressure: aeroplane ki lift, gend ka swing (Magnus effect), filter pump, carburetor (Venturi duct), paint sprayer aur atomizer.
Venturi relation (horizontal pipe): P₁ − P₂ = ½ρ(v₂² − v₁²); v₁ chhota ho to P₁ − P₂ = ½ρv₂² (venturi meter).
Torricelli: v₂ = √(2g(h₁ − h₂)), (h₁ − h₂) se girti cheez ki speed jitni.
